text: You're playing GTA 6 tonight, and before you do, you'll want to know the reviews it got.
Ninety nine on Metacritic. A perfect ten from IGN.
And you can see why. The water, the storms, even the hair look real.
One fan typed: Is this real life?
But the best surprises are in the small stuff.
Pick up a book, and you can open it and read the pages. One of twenty-seven to collect.
Steal something, and the cash doesn't hit your pocket. You drop the goods at a lockup, and get paid later.
Get in a car, and the GPS talks you through every turn.
The one thing missing? A full first-person mode. You only go first person when you aim.
The only complaint: thirty frames per second.
One fan summed it up: Bad F P S, but looks good though.
See you at midnight. Which one are you checking first?
